text: Not forthcoming. Don’t tell me!’ Mr. Dick seemed quite frightened. ‘That little man of a doctor, with his head on one side,’ said my aunt, ‘Jellips, or whatever his name was, what was he about? All he could do, was to say to me, like a robin redbreast--as he is--“It’s a boy.” A boy! Yah, the imbecility of the whole set of ‘em!’ The heartiness of the ejaculation startled Mr. Dick exceedingly; and me, too, if I am to tell the truth.
